title: View Transform nemar.sensor-layout, Version 1
description: Applied on top of the envelope to a view declaration whose transform is nemar.sensor-layout.v1 (docs/views/sensor-layout.md): three-dimensional sensor positions to a layout of theta and radius. The positions are either a stored data role positions, which names its own frame (coordinate_system, or n/a with a montage), so the transform takes no parameters; or the view's one input, the role positions, a TSV file of the run's product with the columns name, x, y and z, whose frame the transform's parameters name. The frame is declared once, never twice.

then.description: Stored positions: the role names the frame, and the view has no inputs.

inputs.description: Stored positions are not also an input.

parameters.description: The positions role names the frame.

else.description: Positions as an input: the parameters name the frame.

inputs.description: The role positions, a TSV file of the run's product.

coordinate_system.description: The Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) name of the positions' coordinate system, or n/a for template positions that name their montage. Any name passes the schema; the transform refuses one whose orientation it does not know (frame_unknown), and a renderer then places the sensors by name.

montage.description: For template positions: the montage of views/montages they were taken from (nemar.sensor-labels.v1). Every montage file is in a right-anterior-superior frame, in meters, so the coordinate system is then n/a.
